segments.name: Digital security technology
segments.description: Provides digital security solutions and real estate management services to enterprise customers in China.
segments.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company derived revenue for rending digital security services and real estate management services.

revenueModel.text: Enterprise customers pay fixed contract prices for customized digital security systems with included warranties, and for real estate management services.
revenueModel.evidence: The contracts specify fixed transaction prices with no variable consideration.

changes.text: In 2024, the company sold Chutian HK and divested its microfinance lending business.
